name: gkmur
description: Gabriel Murray's personal Claude skills marketplace

plugins.name: pretext-typography
plugins.description: Advanced web typography via @chenglou/pretext — drop caps, pull quotes, image flow-around, canvas/SVG text. Use when typography needs to flow around obstacles or do anything CSS can't.

plugins.name: moodboard
plugins.description: Your saved visual taste, as a creative mind your AI can draw on. Point it at any reference library (folders of images, a Pinterest mirror, screenshots) - it compiles a reusable taste profile once, then applies your aesthetic to anything you build with an adjustable influence dial: strictly mirror one reference, channel a collection, or let your whole taste quietly season the work. No external services; everything runs on local files.

plugins.name: session-state
plugins.description: Session continuity: the wrap-up skill writes a worktree-safe .claude/STATE.md whiteboard so the next session answers 'where were we?'. Pairs with the SessionStart auto-load hook.

plugins.name: rubin
plugins.description: Gabe's creative therapist and pattern-catcher - a warm, plain-spoken thinking partner that knows his stuff. Pulls from his wiki/second brain to connect what he's saying now to what he's already decided or kept circling, then suggests one concrete thing to try. Talks one turn at a time - reflect, name a thread, offer a move, stop. Stands down on anything with a checkable correct answer. Local-only: depends on the wiki MCP (gbrain on the Mac mini).

plugins.name: writing-voice
plugins.description: Write in Gabe's actual voice - Slack, email, comments, anything drafted on his behalf. Medium-independent voice DNA (ask-first, brief, warm, active, zero-corporate, honest hedges, no sign-offs) plus a deep-evidence Slack mechanics section distilled from ~3,100 of his real sent Slack messages (2022-2026), with register shifts for peers vs reports vs leadership vs broadcast.

plugins.name: skill-improver
plugins.description: Statistically improve an existing Claude skill via a dynamic multi-agent workflow — eval-driven A/B, trigger tuning, adversarial weakness hunt, and clarity rewrite, each backed by repeated trials and adversarial verification — then gate every proposed change through grill-me before applying. Point it at a SKILL.md and it returns a ranked, evidence-backed change proposal.

plugins.name: adhd
plugins.description: Shape output for an ADHD reader: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /adhd; stays on until 'stop adhd mode'. Optional always-on SessionStart hook.

plugins.name: maintainer-orchestrator
plugins.description: Run a single orchestrator session that wakes on a heartbeat, triages every personal repo's queue, and directs one background worker agent per repo to land safe work autonomously - escalating only decision-ready briefs to Gabe. Claude Code port of steipete's Codex maintainer loop: /loop 5m heartbeat, background agents as worker threads, SendMessage to steer, gh-driven triage, PR-only landings.
